dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Canela is at risk due to behavioral concerns. According to Canela's previous owner, she was reported to hard bark and growl at strangers and when her food or treats were touched. At the Care Centers, Canela is highly reactive to neighboring dogs and has engaged in kennel fighting when being removed from or returned to her kennel. When she is not near other dogs, Canela participates in training, including "leave it" training to address her resource guarding. She is highly social with staff and volunteers. Medically, Canela has dermatitis.
dog.name: Canela
